cases.name: Lisa Ann Carnes
cases.narrative: On 3/30/1984, her body was found in a field in rural Massac County near Macedonia Church Road and US Highway 45. Her clothes were found along Route 45 and her vehicle was parked miles away. She was shot through the shoulder and the bullet traveled through her lung.
